major_updates: SPPS terminal last wash corrected to DMF x3 followed by DCM x3 without redundant terminal post-coupling DMF x2
Compound DB normalized with separated reagent MW and product contribution MW
Docking Workbench collapsible Input and full-data windows added
PRODIGY-like/GROMACS-like/MD-style reporting tables preserved and documented
PyMOL Structure Builder quick-safe bridge export preserved

data_policy.blank_policy: Blank values are used for manual-required or vendor-form-dependent rows; they are not automatically data loss.

scope_boundary: Research planning, screening, bridge export, and evidence reporting. Not final binding proof, not production QC, not replacement for external docking or MD.
github_upload_notes: This package is intended to be uploaded directly as the repository contents.
Runtime outputs, build artifacts, caches, and executable artifacts are excluded by .gitignore.
Use tag v2.0.0 for this clean baseline.
